main_argument_chains.claim: A self-sufficient colony of 10,000 grows under a scaled birth rate, pays skilled work slightly more, and accepts a little income inequality because full equality worsens segregation.
support_steps: Advance the age mix with a quasi-Markov chain and pick the stable start
Size each occupation from demand, yield and borrowed ratios
Tie schooling to income with two fits and set 11.02 years
Compute GDP from three wage tiers and cross-check it
Show tiered pay lowers dissimilarity and raises the happiness index
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Send 4,000 young and 6,000 working-age settlers, keep services public, tier the wages, and prefer gradual migration.
